origin.description: Trim both sides and replace each internal whitespace run with one space.

arguments.name: string
arguments.text: Input vector. Either a character vector, or something coercible to one.

origin.details: Internal tabs and newlines become a single space, then both ends are trimmed.
origin.value: A character vector the same length as string.
origin.example:
print(str_squish("  String with trailing,  middle, and leading white space	"))
print(str_squish("

String with excess,  trailing and leading white   space

"))
